name: video_transcribe
description: Extract audio from a video and transcribe it to text via STT. Returns what was said per timestamp. Process is async with job_id - start with video_path, then poll with job_id. Video is not saved, only metadata is sent.

job_id.description: Job ID to poll status. If provided, returns job status.

language.description: Language hint for transcription, e.g. ar, en. Default auto.
